---
name: Infrastructure stack decision
description: Decided to migrate from Cloudflare Workers to Firebase + Vercel
type: project
---

Decided to migrate away from Cloudflare Workers to a Firebase + Vercel stack.

**Why:** Cloudflare Workers has a 25 MB bundle limit that becomes a hard blocker at 1,779+ articles (~60-70 MB of content JSON). KV/D1 migration would be required and adds operational complexity. The `@opennextjs/cloudflare` adapter also lags behind Next.js and causes friction.

**New stack:**
- **Images → Firebase Storage (GCS)** — replaces `public/images/dreams/` in git (was 795 MB, blocking deployment)
- **Content JSON → Firestore** — replaces `data/content/{category}/{slug}.json` filesystem reads; 50k reads/day free tier, scales to any article count
- **Hosting → Vercel Hobby** — free, native Next.js, no adapter complexity
- **Taxonomy → stays on filesystem** — small/stable files, fine to bundle
- **Image generation → stays on Google Cloud** (Imagen 4, same GCP project as Firebase)

**How to apply:**
1. Move images to Firebase Storage, update image URLs in content JSONs
2. Migrate content JSONs to Firestore (one document per article, keyed by slug)
3. Update `src/lib/content.ts` to read from Firestore SDK instead of `fs`
4. Keep `src/lib/taxonomy.ts` on filesystem
5. Remove `@opennextjs/cloudflare`, deploy to Vercel
6. Pipeline agents: write to Firestore instead of local JSON files (or write both during transition)

**Note:** Vercel Hobby has 10s function timeout — fine for single Firestore reads (50-200ms each). Do not do batch reads in a single request.

# Project Memory: my-fortune-site (꿈해몽)

## Key Behavioral Rules
- [feedback_no_autonomous_execution.md] — Never launch agents or pipelines unless explicitly asked. "Pick up where we left off" = brief on state, then wait.

## Project Overview
Korean dream interpretation website (꿈해몽) — bilingual KO + EN, SEO-first, ad revenue model.
- Target: Both Naver and Google
- Language: Korean + English with language switch toggle
- Runtime: Next.js on Vercel Hobby
- Content: LLM-generated from scratch

## Infrastructure (COMPLETE ✅ as of 2026-03-13)
See [project_infrastructure_decision.md] for full context.
- **Hosting**: Vercel Hobby (replacing Cloudflare Workers + @opennextjs/cloudflare)
- **Images**: Firebase Storage — `gs://my-fortune-site.firebasestorage.app` (asia-northeast3). Public URL: `https://storage.googleapis.com/my-fortune-site.firebasestorage.app/images/dreams/{slug}/{name}.webp`. Format: WebP (~90% smaller than original PNGs).
- **Content JSON**: Firestore collection `dreams`, doc ID = english slug (408 docs migrated)
- **Taxonomy**: stays on filesystem (`data/taxonomy/*.json`) — small/stable
- **Image generation**: Imagen 4 (`imagen-4.0-generate-001`), same GCP project as Firebase
- **`public/images/dreams/`**: in `.gitignore`, removed from git tracking
- **Env vars required**: `FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID`, `FIREBASE_CLIENT_EMAIL`, `FIREBASE_PRIVATE_KEY`
- **Key files**: `src/lib/firestore.ts` (Admin SDK singleton), `src/lib/content.ts` (Firestore reads)
- **Migration scripts**: `scripts/migrate-images-to-firebase.mjs`, `scripts/migrate-content-to-firestore.mjs`
- **Next step**: Deploy to Vercel (remove @opennextjs/cloudflare, set env vars in Vercel dashboard)

## Agents Created
All in `.claude/agents/`:
- `dream-taxonomy-agent` — enumerates all dream symbols → `data/taxonomy/*.json`
- `dream-research-agent` — researches one symbol deeply → `data/research/{category}/{slug}.json`
- `dream-content-agent` — generates bilingual SEO page content → `data/content/{category}/{slug}.json`
- `dream-image-agent` — generates images via Imagen 4 → `public/images/dreams/{slug}/` + uploads to Firebase
- `meta-agent` — creates new subagents (use for new agent creation)
- Custom agents (.claude/agents/*.md) cannot be used as subagent_type — read .md and pass to general-purpose agent

## Data Pipeline
```
dream-taxonomy-agent
  → data/taxonomy/*.json
      ↓ per symbol (parallel: research + image)
dream-research-agent → data/research/{category}/{slug}.json
dream-image-agent    → Firebase Storage + public/images/dreams/{slug}/
      ↓
dream-content-agent  → data/content/{category}/{slug}.json + Firestore (dreams/{slug})
      ↓
Next.js dynamic pages (reads from Firestore)
```

## Data Schema
### Taxonomy entry
`id`, `korean`, `english`, `slug`, `category`, `subcategory`, `related`, `searchTier` (high/medium/longtail)

### Research entry (`data/research/{category}/{slug}.json`)
- `symbol`: { korean, english, slug }
- `summary`: { korean, english }
- `interpretations`: [{ type: 길몽|흉몽|neutral, korean, english, context }]
- `variations`: [{ keyword_ko, keyword_en, interpretation_ko, interpretation_en }]
- `culturalContext`: { korean, english }
- `westernContext`: { freudian, jungian, modern, crossCultural } — each { korean, english }
- `relatedSymbols`: string[] (slugs)
- `seoKeywords`: { korean[], english[] }
- `faqs`: [{ question_ko, answer_ko, question_en, answer_en }]

### Content entry (`data/content/{category}/{slug}.json` + Firestore `dreams/{slug}`)
- ko + en versions of: title, metaDescription, h1, intro, sections, variations, culturalContext, westernContext, faqs, conclusion
- images: { hero: Firebase Storage URL, sections: { auspicious, inauspicious } }
- seo: { slug, koreanSlug, ogTitle, ogDescription, ogImage, structuredData, hreflang, relatedSlugs, naverSEO }
- **`relatedSlugs` must be inside `seo` object** (not root level)

### Image manifest (`data/images/{slug}/manifest.json`)
Written AFTER image generation — audit trail only, NOT used as input to Imagen 4.
Contains: prompts used, output paths, alt text (KO+EN), provider, generatedAt.

## Hooks (`.claude/settings.json`)
- PreToolUse: blocks .env access + dangerous rm -rf (via pre_tool_use.py)
- Stop: logs to logs/stop.json
- SubagentStop: logs to logs/subagent_stop.json
- Notification (permission_prompt only): logs to logs/notification.json

## App Structure (implemented, build ✅)
- `src/middleware.ts` → next-intl locale routing (deprecation: rename to proxy.ts in Next.js 16)
- `src/i18n/routing.ts` → locales + pathnames map (ko: /꿈해몽/[slug], en: /dream/[slug], + /탐색/[category])
- `src/lib/firestore.ts` → Firebase Admin SDK singleton (credentials from env vars)
- `src/lib/taxonomy.ts` → server-only, fs/promises, reads data/taxonomy/*.json
- `src/lib/content.ts` → server-only, Firestore reads via Admin SDK
- `src/components/layout/` → Header, Footer
- `src/components/dream/` → DreamHero, DreamSection, DreamVariations, DreamFAQ, RelatedDreams, DreamCard
- `src/components/common/AdSlot.tsx` → placeholder ad div (ready for AdSense)
- `src/components/home/SearchBar.tsx` → client component search form
- `src/components/explore/CategoryDreamList.tsx` → client component with subcategory filter pills
- `next.config.ts` → remotePatterns for storage.googleapis.com (Firebase Storage images)
- `public/images/home/hero.png` → homepage hero background (in git, fine — only dreams/ is excluded)

## Content Progress — PHASE 1 COMPLETE ✅ (2026-03-13)
- **408 articles total** across all 24 categories
- Content in `data/content/{category}/{slug}.json` + mirrored in Firestore
- All images in Firebase Storage as WebP
- Batch size: 6 agents in parallel (confirmed optimal — more causes rate limit crashes)
- Image generation: Imagen 4 via Google Generative Language API. `source ~/.zshrc` required for GOOGLE_API_KEY.

name: Infrastructure stack decision
description: Migrated from Cloudflare Workers to Firebase Storage + Firestore + Vercel Hobby — COMPLETE
type: project
---

Migrated away from Cloudflare Workers to a Firebase + Vercel stack. **COMPLETE as of 2026-03-13.**

**Why:** Cloudflare Workers has a 25 MB bundle limit that becomes a hard blocker at 1,779+ articles (~60-70 MB of content JSON). The `@opennextjs/cloudflare` adapter also lags behind Next.js and causes friction.

**Stack (live):**
- **Images → Firebase Storage** (`gs://my-fortune-site.firebasestorage.app`, asia-northeast3). All 404 slug folders uploaded as WebP. Public URL: `https://storage.googleapis.com/my-fortune-site.firebasestorage.app/images/dreams/{slug}/{name}.webp`. `public/images/dreams/` is in `.gitignore`.
- **Content JSON → Firestore** — collection `dreams`, doc ID = english slug. 408 docs. `src/lib/content.ts` reads via Admin SDK (`src/lib/firestore.ts`).
- **Hosting → Vercel Hobby** — next step is to deploy (remove @opennextjs/cloudflare, set env vars)
- **Taxonomy → stays on filesystem** — small/stable files, fine to bundle
- **Image generation → stays on Google Cloud** (Imagen 4, same GCP project as Firebase)

**Env vars required:** `FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID`, `FIREBASE_CLIENT_EMAIL`, `FIREBASE_PRIVATE_KEY`

**How to apply:**
- New content written by agents goes to `data/content/{category}/{slug}.json` locally, then must be synced to Firestore via `scripts/migrate-content-to-firestore.mjs`
- New images go to `public/images/dreams/{slug}/` locally, then uploaded to Firebase via `scripts/migrate-images-to-firebase.mjs`
- Vercel Hobby has 10s function timeout — fine for single Firestore reads (50-200ms each). Do not do batch reads in a single request.
